read_sources: canonical WEB Hosea coordinates and text
independence_scope.contamination_disclosure: A broad repository search accidentally displayed one M6 Hosea row proposing Hos.1.1-Hos.2.1. That row was not treated as a vote or adopted as a unit; this proposal instead separates Hos.1.1, Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9, and Hos.1.10-Hos.2.1. Because the prohibited row was seen, the boss must decide whether this artifact can count as blind or must be rerun by a fresh reviewer.

non_authority_statement: Candidate literary and rhetorical evidence only. No theology, canon, authorship, date, historicity, ethics, identity, fulfillment, preferred witness, reading, translation, source tradition, graph, retrieval, promotion, or reviewed-gold authority.
routing_principle: Prefer complete sign-act, lawsuit, accusation-response, poem, metaphor sequence, summons, lament, and restoration movements. Split only at clear address, speaker, imperative, image-field, oracle, refrain, or closure seams; preserve tightly coupled accusation and consequence, question and response, and recalled-history sequences.

macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Marriage, names, lawsuit, reversal, and renewed sign action mutually interpret one another.
Successive summons widen one lawsuit before the return speech.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: return speech and divine response through failed turning

macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Alarm, cult, alliance, exile, kingship, and war form a sustained cycle.
Egypt, Jacob, Ephraim, return, care, and fruit imagery bind the closing movement.

global_hot_zones.issue: Promise/name reversal crosses chapter and versification seam.
Mother, wife, children, land, and speakers shift.
global_hot_zones.handling: Use rhetorical turns only; defer referents and ethics.

global_hot_zones.issue: Woman identity and purchase wording disputed.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve whole sign; no identity or textual choice.

global_hot_zones.issue: Alarm, withdrawal, and return speech shift speaker.
global_hot_zones.handling: Separate at communal exhortation without judging sincerity.
Keep exemplum and exhortation; no harmonization.

global_hot_zones.issue: Questions, quotations, and compassion turn disputed.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep inside larger LOW movement; decide no doctrine.

global_hot_zones.issue: Lexical/textual difficulty in offered words/bulls phrase.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep whole liturgy; no wording choice.
Justified form exception with whole-close alternative.

units.title: Word-event superscription
units.literary_form: prophetic superscription
units.deciding_marker: Third-person word-event formula, prophet identification, and regnal frame precede the enacted command at verse 2.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not fold the superscription into the marriage action or use the regnal list to decide date or authorship.
units.risk: A single-verse unit is justified by superscription form, not proof-text value.

units.title: Marriage command and three sign-children
units.literary_form: enacted prophetic sign narrative with repeated naming oracles
units.deciding_marker: Initial command leads through marriage and three birth-name cycles; verse 10 reverses the final name oracle in poetic promise.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split each child into an isolated proof text or decide the sign biography and ethics.
units.risk: Marriage vocabulary, paternity, chronology, and ethical judgments remain deferred.

units.title: Reversal promise and renamed kin
units.literary_form: restoration oracle with name-reversal commission
units.deciding_marker: The not-my-people formula is reversed, Judah and Israel are gathered, Jezreel is revalued, and the audience is told to speak restored names.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not stop at the chapter boundary or detach the command to rename brothers and sisters.
units.risk: Versification and relation to the surrounding sign complex remain held.

units.title: Contend with the unfaithful mother
units.literary_form: marital lawsuit, accusation, threatened exposure, and deprivation
units.deciding_marker: Double contend imperative opens the case; lover and provision accusations accumulate through the closing Baal-days visitation formula.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize each therefore, lover, feast, or agricultural deprivation image.
units.risk: Speaker, mother/land/wife referents, sexual violence imagery, and ethics remain deferred.

units.title: Allurement, renewed betrothal, and name reversal
units.literary_form: restoration wooing oracle with repeated in-that-day stanzas
units.deciding_marker: A new therefore-behold reverses direction from deprivation to wilderness speech, covenant peace, betrothal, cosmic response, and restored names.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate betrothal or name reversal from the full restorative sequence.
units.risk: Metaphor referents, covenant theology, and future fulfillment remain non-authoritative.

units.title: Love again: second sign action and explanation
units.literary_form: command-performance-speech sign narrative with interpretive coda
units.deciding_marker: Go-again command, purchase, imposed waiting, and for-explanation form one complete sign act.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split action from explanation or identify the woman by harmonizing chapter 1.
units.risk: Woman identity, transaction, voice, cult terms, David reference, and temporal formula remain deferred.

units.title: Land controversy and creation-wide mourning
units.literary_form: covenant-lawsuit summons, charge list, and consequence
units.deciding_marker: Hear plus explicit charge opens a new collection; no-truth indictment leads through bloodshed to land-wide mourning.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the ecological consequence from the land charge.
units.risk: Covenant and ecological applications remain outside boundary authority.

units.title: People and priest stumble together
units.literary_form: prohibition, priestly accusation, and reciprocal consequence
units.deciding_marker: Yet-let-no-one shifts address; knowledge, law, priest, sin, eating, and abandonment recur through the consequence close.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not force a precise addressee split from ambiguous pronouns or isolate 4:6.
units.risk: Priest/people addressee, syntax, and translation remain held.

units.title: Cultic infidelity and shared culpability
units.literary_form: maxim expanded into cult accusation and consequence
units.deciding_marker: Wine-prostitution maxim initiates consultation and high-place accusation; therefore clauses expose both women and men before ruin.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the opening maxim or place culpability only on the women named.
units.risk: Cult vocabulary, sexuality, gender, and social application remain deferred.

units.title: Warning to Judah over stubborn Ephraim
units.literary_form: direct warning, animal comparison, and compressed doom sayings
units.deciding_marker: Though-you-Israel and do-not-let-Judah imperatives change addressee; Ephraim sayings run to wind-borne disappointment.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate leave-him-alone or decide every compressed pronoun.
units.risk: Place names, cult terms, pronouns, and interregional application remain held.

units.title: Priests, Israel, and royal house summoned
units.literary_form: threefold hearing summons and prosecutorial judgment oracle
units.deciding_marker: Listen-listen-give-ear summons three groups; knowledge, prostitution, stumbling, failed seeking, and new-moon consequence form one address.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split each audience or detach failed worship from the charge.
units.risk: Historical sites, calendar, priestly and royal referents remain deferred.

units.title: Battle alarm, incurable wound, and withdrawal
units.literary_form: alarm oracle, paired diagnosis, predator threat, and withdrawal
units.deciding_marker: Trumpet commands initiate alarm; repeated Ephraim/Judah pairs culminate in lion imagery and withdrawal until seeking.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach Assyria failed cure or final withdrawal from the alarm sequence.
units.risk: War setting, King Jareb, wrath, and historical fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Communal invitation to return
units.literary_form: quoted penitential or confidence liturgy
units.deciding_marker: Come-let-us-return opens first-person plural speech with heal-revive-know-rain progression; divine address resumes at verse 4.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not decide the speech sincerity, doctrine, or chronology.
units.risk: Speaker identity, sincerity, two/three-day formula, and reception remain deferred.

units.title: Fleeting loyalty and iniquity exposed at healing
units.literary_form: divine response, accusation catalogue, and chapter-crossing healing lament
units.deciding_marker: What-shall-I-do questions answer the return speech; love/knowledge contrasts lead through breach and bloodshed to when-I-would-heal and remembered deeds.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not let the chapter boundary divide 6:11 from 7:1 or detach 6:6 as a slogan.
units.risk: Clause attachment at 6:11, Adam/place, priest accusation, and healing syntax remain held.

units.title: Oven-hot court conspiracy
units.literary_form: royal corruption satire sustained by oven imagery
units.deciding_marker: King and princes enter as recipients of wickedness; repeated oven heat moves from intrigue to devoured judges and fallen kings.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split each oven comparison or infer a particular coup chronology.
units.risk: Court history and ruler identities remain deferred.

units.title: Mixed, unturned, and unaware Ephraim
units.literary_form: compact nation-metaphor stanza and refrain
units.deciding_marker: Ephraim anaphora introduces mixed pancake and gray-hair images; double does-not-realize culminates in not-returned refrain.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the pancake image or merge it across the fresh dove address.
units.risk: Translation of the food image and political application remain non-authoritative.

units.title: Dove, net, false cry, and faulty bow
units.literary_form: animal-metaphor accusation and woe oracle
units.deciding_marker: New dove simile begins foreign-policy movement; net, woe, failed crying, and faulty-bow close cohere.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach Egypt/Assyria from the dove and bow frame or decide chronology.
units.risk: Foreign alliances, assembly wording, and repentance claims remain deferred.

units.title: Trumpet alarm over covenant, kings, and calf
units.literary_form: alarm command, covenant accusation, and idol taunt
units.deciding_marker: Trumpet imperative opens warning; false acknowledgment, rulers, and Samaria calf culminate in craftsman-not-god declaration.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate calf, king, or cry.
units.risk: Political history, covenant theology, and cult object identity remain deferred.

units.title: Sowing wind and hiring lovers
units.literary_form: sowing-reaping proverb expanded into nation and alliance satire
units.deciding_marker: For-they-sow introduces consequence imagery; strangers swallowing produce worthless-vessel and hired-lover sequence through oppression.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not separate sow-reap from national and alliance consequences.
units.risk: Gathering syntax, mighty king title, and Assyrian context remain held.

units.title: Altars, estranged instruction, and rejected sacrifice
units.literary_form: cultic accusation and paired Israel-Judah judgment
units.deciding_marker: Multiplied altars shift to law-sacrifice sequence; Israel-forgot and Judah-multiplied close with fire.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate law, sacrifice, Egypt, palaces, or fortified cities.
units.risk: Legal corpus, sacrifice, Egypt metaphor, and judgment application remain deferred.

units.title: No harvest joy, feast, or home
units.literary_form: festival prohibition and exile-lament oracle
units.deciding_marker: Do-not-rejoice opens; threshing floor, unclean food, lost offerings, feast question, flight, burial, and overgrown tents form one movement.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split the feast question from its exile and burial answer.
units.risk: Festival, purity, geography, and historical setting remain deferred.

units.title: Reckoning, rejected prophet, and Gibeah
units.literary_form: arrival announcement and prophet-watchman lament
units.deciding_marker: Days-have-come shifts to reckoning and hostile reception; Gibeah analogy closes the stanza.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate prophet labels or decide which speaker calls whom foolish.
units.risk: Speaker, prophet/watchman syntax, Gibeah, and historical analogy remain held.

units.title: Wilderness fruit, Peor loss, and failed fertility
units.literary_form: recalled-foundling metaphor turning to birth-loss lament and interrupted prayer
units.deciding_marker: I-found and I-saw recall first fruit; Peor turn yields bird-flight glory and birth-death sequence ending in prayer.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate prayer or fertility images from the Peor-to-bereavement sequence.
units.risk: Peor, Tyre reading, violence, and prayer rhetoric remain deferred.

units.title: Gilgal rejection, root death, and wandering
units.literary_form: place-focused rejection oracle with prophetic closing comment
units.deciding_marker: All-wickedness-in-Gilgal starts a new indictment; root and womb images lead to my-God closing voice and wandering.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach verse 17 merely because possessive voice changes.
units.risk: Speaker change, love language, violence, and Gilgal remain held.

units.title: Vine, divided heart, lost king, and calf
units.literary_form: extended agricultural-cultic indictment and collapse oracle
units.deciding_marker: Israel-is-a-vine introduces irony; heart, king, covenant, calf, Assyria, floating king, and ruined high places accumulate to mountain cries.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate vine, calf, king, or cover-us cry.
units.risk: Cult sites, king, Assyria, and later reuse remain deferred.

units.title: Gibeah, heifer, sowing call, and battle harvest
units.literary_form: historical accusation, heifer metaphor, exhortation, and sow-reap reversal
units.deciding_marker: Gibeah begins a second movement; heifer/plowing supports sow-righteousness, answered by plowed-wickedness and battle consequence.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach exhortation from agricultural indictment and war outcome.
units.risk: Gibeah, two transgressions, Shalman/Beth Arbel, violence, and chronology remain held.

units.title: Loved child, failed response, and refused return
units.literary_form: parent-child recollection turning to accusation and judgment
units.deciding_marker: When-Israel-was-a-child opens call, teaching, carrying, healing, and feeding; verses 5-7 turn to king, sword, and bent-away people.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate son-out-of-Egypt or use later reuse to set the boundary.
units.risk: Pronouns, Egypt/Assyria, parental metaphor, and later reception remain deferred.

units.title: How can I give you up?
units.literary_form: divine lament, compassion turn, lion call, and homecoming oracle
units.deciding_marker: Four how-can-I questions interrupt destruction; heart and compassion lead to not-destroy, roar, trembling return, and settlement.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate verse 9 or detach homecoming from the compassion turn.
units.risk: Divine-emotion language, holy-one statement, geography, and fulfillment remain non-authoritative.

units.title: Ephraim deceit and Jacob controversy
units.literary_form: chapter-crossing controversy using Jacob exemplum and exhortation
units.deciding_marker: Ephraim/Judah accusation crosses into alliances; explicit controversy introduces Jacob heel, struggle, Bethel, divine name, and therefore-return.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not cut at chapter seam or isolate Jacob episodes from kindness-and-justice exhortation.
units.risk: Versification, Judah syntax, angel/God pronouns, Bethel speech, and allusion direction remain held.

units.title: Dishonest merchant, tents, prophets, and Jacob service
units.literary_form: accusation-response with recalled-history contrasts
units.deciding_marker: Merchant scales begin wealth boast and Egypt/tents response; prophets, Gilgal, Jacob service, prophetic exodus, and repayment cohere.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate merchant, feast, prophets, or Jacob notices as historical claims.
units.risk: Merchant lexical range, festival, prophet claims, allusions, and bloodguilt remain deferred.

units.title: Ephraim rise, Baal guilt, and vanishing
units.literary_form: retrospective accusation and fourfold transience simile
units.deciding_marker: When-Ephraim-spoke begins rise-death retrospective; idol making leads to mist, dew, chaff, and smoke.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate sacrifice wording or each image.
units.risk: Human-sacrifice syntax, calf practice, and historical sequence remain held.

units.title: Wilderness care forgotten and predator encounter
units.literary_form: exodus self-identification, care recollection, and animal-attack judgment
units.deciding_marker: Yet-I-am-Yahweh recalls Egypt, wilderness knowing, pasture, fullness, forgetting, then lion-leopard-bear attack.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate savior statement or split each predator.
units.risk: Theology, wilderness history, and violence remain non-authoritative.

units.title: Failed kingship, stored guilt, death taunt, and fall
units.literary_form: rhetorical interrogation, birth-death crisis, and violent judgment
units.deciding_marker: Destroyed/where-is-your-king initiates questions; stored guilt and labor lead through death/Sheol speech to east wind and Samaria consequence.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 13:14, choose its interrogative force, or detach it from birth, compassion, wind, and death imagery.
units.risk: Text and quotation in 13:14, kingship, reception, violence, and ethics remain deferred.

units.title: Return with words
units.literary_form: return summons containing a model communal confession
units.deciding_marker: Israel-return opens final appeal; take-words instructs petition renouncing Assyria, horses, and handmade gods.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach liturgy from summons or select a preferred text at 14:2.
units.risk: Textual wording in 14:2, ritual substitution, repentance, and politics remain held.

units.title: Healing response and flourishing Israel
units.literary_form: restorative answer sustained by botanical imagery
units.deciding_marker: I-will-heal answers the return liturgy; growth images culminate in renunciation of idols and fruit-from-me closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split each botanical image or isolate the idol question.
units.risk: Plant identifications, speaker shifts in 14:8, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Wisdom epilogue on the ways
units.literary_form: editorial-style wisdom epilogue
units.deciding_marker: Who-is-wise and who-is-prudent shift from oracle voice to sapiential reader address and close with a two-way maxim.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not merge away the genre shift or make it authority over every preceding ambiguity.
units.risk: Single-verse unit justified by epilogue form; authorship and redaction remain undecided.
